title: Review Timeliness Scale for Wrong Drop-Off Reviews, Wayfare Rides
content:
The review timeliness factor of a wrong drop-off review on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** counts the calendar days from the charge date of the trip's fare charge to today.

**Scale.** At least the late review days of 21 take the late review timeliness factor of 0.7; at least the mid review days of 8 but fewer than 21 take the mid review timeliness factor of 0.85; fewer than 8 days are not reduced.

| Calendar days from the fare charge date to today | Review timeliness factor |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | not reduced |
| at least 8, fewer than 21 | 0.85 |
| 21 or more | 0.7 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical; fare charged on 10 September)

| Today | Days since the charge date | Factor |
|---|---|---|
| 17 September | 7 | not reduced |
| 18 September | 8 | 0.85 |
| 30 September | 20 | 0.85 |
| 1 October | 21 | 0.7 |

The days are counted as calendar dates, from the charge date to today.
